head: codex/5823-v0-92-wp-06-remote-validation-build-runner
title: [v0.92][WP-06] Harden remote validation runners
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5823

## Summary
- preserve complete command-profile working-directory and environment boundaries across remote adapters
- prevent local fallback from masquerading as successful remote proof
- harden AWS and Nessus cancellation, cleanup, cost, redaction, and exact-revision behavior
- retain one final native Linux run at substantive revision 2c76b1f8 plus native macOS and fixture-qualified Windows evidence

## Validation
- AWS portable adapter tests: 26/26
- portable remote-validation contract tests: 11/11
- focused AWS and Nessus shell suites: PASS
- final native Linux AWS run: PASS, cleanup complete, estimated compute cost $0.008732
- platform-matrix validator and self-test: PASS
- shell syntax and git diff hygiene: PASS

## Review
- exact-head review authority is retained in the typed C-SDLC review record

## Boundaries
- Windows proof remains fixture-qualified rather than live-native
- source execution is pinned to substantive revision 2c76b1f8; later commits contain validation and retained evidence only
